PoroBot

Hi! I'm PoroBot 🤖

I can help you with:
• 🃏 MTG commander deck building (powered by EDHREC)
• 🔗 MTG card synergies ("I have Sol Ring, what else?")
• 🔍 MTG card search by strategy or keyword
• 🎨 MTG by color, rarity, type, condition ("red mythic creatures", "foil Japanese cards")
• ⚡ Pokemon card searches
• 🎨 Pokemon by look ("cute fluffy Pokemon", "fierce dragons")
• 🗂️ Pokemon by set ("full art cards from Crown Zenith")
• 🎁 Pokemon gift suggestions ("My son likes Pikachu, what else?")
• 🎲 Accessories — sleeves, dice, deck boxes
• 🔥 Popular & trending products from real sales ("what's hot in MTG?", "top sellers")
• 🤝 MTG co-purchase ("what cards do people buy with Sol Ring?")
• 📦 Order status (requires login)
• 💰 Selling cards to Poromagia ("how do I sell my Pokemon cards?")
• 🏬 Store location & opening hours ("where is your store?")
• 🎟️ Gift cards ("how do I use a gift card?")
• 📞 Contact info ("how can I contact you?")
• 🚚 Shipping & delivery ("do you ship to Japan?")
• 💳 Payment methods ("how can I pay?")
• ↩️ Returns & refunds
• ⭐ Poro Club credits ("do my credits expire?")
• 🏅 PSA grading ("how does grading work?")
• 📋 Card condition guide ("what's the difference between NM and EX?")
• 🏆 Tournaments & events

Try asking me something!
🌐 You can switch language (EN / FI / SV) any time from the menu at the top.
AI-generated recommendations may not always be accurate. Please verify details.
